# SCANsat

Brings [SCANsat](https://github.com/S-C-A-N/SCANsat)'s orbital survey data onto the
mission-control dashboard: what has been scanned, by which craft, and where the
anomalies are.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Uplink id | `scansat` |
| Version | `0.0.1` |
| Wraps | SCANsat 20.4 (CKAN) |
| Built against | contract 13.2, api 1.0.0, ui-kit 0.2.0 |

## Wire

| Topic | Delivery |
| --- | --- |
| `scansat.available` | lossy-latest |
| `scansat.scanningVessels` | lossy-latest |
| `scansat.science` | lossy-latest |

## Widgets

### Scanning

SCANsat status: per-scan-type coverage of the current body, the list of vessels
SCANsat is tracking with their on-board scanners and live in-range state, and the
body's known anomalies with discovery state.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Widget id | `scanning` |
| Reads | `scansat.available`, `scansat.scanningVessels`, `vessel.identity`, `system.bodies`, `vessel.surface`, `vessel.flight` |
| Slots | `scanning.sections` |
| Default size | 6 × 10 |

![Kerbin part-scanned: five scan types at different coverage, one satellite with sensors in range, and two known anomalies](docs/assets/kerbin-partial-scan--default.png)
